The investigation did exactly what the expected answer warns against - it attributed unrelated causes (AccessDenied, invalid model ID, missing DynamoDB table) to the reported Bedrock InternalServerError symptom, rather than correctly identifying this as a provider-side issue or correctly scoping the investigation to the actual workload bearing the symptom.</reasoning>
